station_eligibility.basis: The QuotSoft/CNEMC city archive is reproduced by arithmetic means over valid non-control stations in 2023-2024; control sites are excluded.

rule_1.action: set derived station value to NaN before city aggregation
rule_1.basis: Pre-frozen on 2023-2024 development data: exactly two observations, same station and consecutive hours, at the optional instrument upper-range boundary. Other high values are retained.

pm25_station_value_qc.negative_values: none observed in 2023-2024; no generic threshold rule added

city_hour_aggregation.primary: arithmetic mean of all finite eligible non-control station values after the frozen station-level QC rule
city_hour_aggregation.reported_precision_companion: floor(mean + 0.5) for non-negative PM2.5, retained only as a consistency companion; unrounded mean is the modeling target

timestamp_semantics.raw_archive_labels: date + hour, with observed modern files using hour 0..23
timestamp_semantics.interpretation: interpret archived date/hour as China Standard Time civil-clock timestamp; preserve raw date/hour and convert Asia/Shanghai to UTC
timestamp_semantics.hourly_mean_support: PM2.5 is an archived 1-hour mean associated with the source timestamp; the underlying monitoring standard defines point 1-hour means over the preceding one-hour interval
timestamp_semantics.protocol_year_boundary: 2023/2024/2025 roles are defined by Asia/Shanghai local calendar year

coverage_and_validity.canonical_stage: do not delete city-hour aggregates solely by a station-count gate; store multiple validity companions and freeze the downstream benchmark mask separately
coverage_and_validity.candidate_hj_style_rule: if expected city-point count >=4, require >=75%; otherwise require >=50%
coverage_and_validity.reason_for_deferral: temporary network outages and genuine station retirement must not be conflated; existing sensitivity audits show aggregate robustness

public_rebuild_note: Frozen protocol rules only. Historical internal audit receipts and observations are not distributed; users reconstruct and audit their own inputs.
